children: Nordex could benefit from surging power demand from AI, data centers and industrial expansion in the U.S., Mwb analyst Leon Muehlenbruch says in a note. "Despite Washington's tougher stance on wind, attractive generation costs and short deployment times suggest that economics could ultimately outweigh politics," Muehlenbruch says. This would support the German wind-turbine maker, as Europe and particularly Germany approach a potential peak, according to Mwb. Even so, much of the operational improvement is priced in to Nordex's share, and Mwb maintains its buy rating on the stock with a 44-euro price target. Nordex trades 1.0% higher at 39.94 euros. (sarah.sloat@wsj.com)
